sentence: He succeeded ______ dint of hard work and perseverance.
explanation: <By dint of> significa como resultado de; debido a.

sentence: ______ to the fact that she was ill, she couldn't attend the meeting.
explanation: <Owing to> significa debido a.

sentence: The decision was made ______ accordance with company policy.
explanation: <In accordance with> significa de una manera que concuerda con o sigue algo.

sentence: ______ of his experience, he was chosen to lead the team.
explanation: <In view of> significa considerando algo.

sentence: He continued to work, ______ of the difficulties he faced.
explanation: <Irrespective of> significa sin tener en cuenta; independientemente de.

sentence: ______ to popular belief, cats are not always aloof.
explanation: <Contrary to> significa en oposición a.

sentence: The project was completed ______ schedule.
explanation: <Ahead of schedule> significa antes de lo planeado.

sentence: She was appointed director ______ virtue of her extensive experience.
explanation: <By virtue of> significa debido a o por medio de.

sentence: ______ to the new regulations, all employees must undergo training.
explanation: <Pursuant to> significa de conformidad con (una ley o una solicitud).

sentence: He managed to finish the task ______ of his limited resources.
explanation: <In spite of> significa a pesar de.

sentence: ______ to the fact that he was busy, he still helped me.
explanation: <Despite the fact that> significa aunque.

sentence: She spoke ______ if she knew everything about the subject.
explanation: <As if> significa como si.

sentence: ______ as it may seem, he was telling the truth.
explanation: <Strange as it may seem> es una expresión idiomática que significa que puede parecer extraño, pero es verdad.

sentence: ______ it is raining, we will still go for a walk.
explanation: <Even though> significa a pesar de que.

sentence: He studied hard, ______ he might pass the exam.
explanation: <So that> significa para que.

sentence: ______ he is rich, he is not happy.
explanation: <Although> significa a pesar de que.

sentence: He continued to work, ______ of his illness.
explanation: <Regardless of> significa sin tener en cuenta.

sentence: The meeting was postponed ______ account of the bad weather.
explanation: <On account of> significa debido a.

sentence: ______ to the latest reports, the economy is improving.
explanation: <According to> significa según lo declarado por.

sentence: The meeting was cancelled ______ to unforeseen circumstances.
explanation: <Due to> significa debido a.
